n: 800 Series French Door Bottom Mount Refrigerator 36'' Brushed steel
desc: Introducing the revolutionary B36CT81ENS Refrigerator, with a streamlined interior and advanced freshness system designed to keep the ingredients you love fresher longer. The SuperFreezing function ensures that new food is frozen quickly and thereby prevents the other content inside the freezer from defrosting.
hl: Control temperature and monitor with Home Connect
The Home Connect™ app allows you to remotely monitor and control your Bosch refrigerator from your smartphone or tablet.
MultiAirFlow™ maintains consistent temperatures throughout the unit by evenly circulating cool air.
Sits flush with the countertop, with hidden hinges and discreet, tucked away feet.
UltraClarityPro® Water Filter removes an astonishing >99.9% of sediments, including harsh elements like chlorine and chloramine.
FlexBar® creates extra space in your refrigerator and is completely adaptable to you and your needs.
Experience crisp, beautiful LED illumination from corner to corner.
spec: Access Recipes, Remote Monitoring and Control
